I replied to Dana in our DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is 185 seats.

That number comes from Dana's own messages in #north-team, a channel she's in. On 2025-08-20 she said the amendment had been signed the day before and took the account to 180 seats. A few minutes later she corrected it to 185.

I couldn't find the amendment itself in any file Dana can see, so I suggested she check it against the signed copy June Osei-Lark has. The account was also renewed on 2026-03-20. If the deck needs the current seat count rather than the Amendment No. 1 figure, the renewal may have changed it, and I didn't see a number for that.

No approval was needed because a seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure.
